learning_outcomes.text: Has a sufficient background in mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering topics related to their field.
Uses theoretical and applied knowledge in mathematics, natural sciences, and their own fields together for engineering solutions.
Identifies, defines, formulates, and solves engineering problems, and for this purpose, selects and applies appropriate analytical methods and modeling techniques.
Selects and uses modern techniques and tools necessary for engineering applications.
Designs and conducts experiments, collects data, analyzes and interprets results.
Works effectively individually and in multidisciplinary teams.
Accesses information and for this purpose conducts resource research, uses databases and other information sources.
Is aware of the necessity of lifelong learning; monitors developments in science and technology and continuously renews themselves.
Analyzes and designs a system, system component or process to meet desired requirements under realistic constraints; applies modern design methods accordingly.
Communicates effectively verbally and in writing; uses a foreign language at least at the B1 General Level of the European Language Portfolio.
Is aware of the universal and societal impacts of engineering solutions and applications; is aware of entrepreneurship and innovation issues and has knowledge about current problems.
Has a sense of professional and ethical responsibility.
Has awareness of project management, workplace practices, employee health, environment and occupational safety; awareness of the legal consequences of engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Discussion of the purpose of the course and the importance of research training
Basic Concepts: Science, scientific thinking, scientific method and scientific research
Science and ethics, requirements for ethical conduct in science
Scientific research process: Determining the problem, research topic, purpose, assumptions, and limitations
Scientific research process: Planning research and conducting literature review
Data types and data collection methods, organization and analysis of data
Systematic compilation of obtained data, segmentation, titling, preparing a draft for the report; writing summary and conclusion sections
Formal features of the report (Paper size and properties, font style, page layout, line spacing and alignment, paragraph arrangement, cover page, figures and tables)
Transfers, explanations, footnotes, bibliography preparation, appendix arrangement
Selecting research topics and conducting literature review
Evaluating research results and converting them into a report
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
